The '''Tower of Prophecy''' was a prominent location in [[Voss-Ka]], the fortified capital city of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] species native to the [[Voss|planet]] of the same name.<ref name="VossScreen" /> The Voss species greatly valued the gift of prophecy and had developed a unique [[:Category:Force-based organizations|order]] of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force sight|seers]] and [[Force healing/Legends|healers]] known as the [[Voss Mystics]].<ref name="HoloVoss" />

==Characteristics==
The Voss were said to be great lovers of art who had developed a distinct style that had been in existence for thousands of years circa [[3653 BBY]].<ref>{{TORweb|url=media/screens/voss-1|text=Voss}}</ref> The architecture of the Tower of Prophecy, and Voss-Ka as a whole, followed this distinctive style.<ref name="VossScreen" />

Within the building were the Voss leaders, as well as the Voss Mystics and their interpreters. The Tower of Prophecy was the heart of the government and culture of Voss, to which those seeking wisdom would travel in hope of finding answers from the Voss Mystics. Rising above the main halls of the Tower of Prophecy were two tall [[Meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chambers]], reserved only for the Mystics. To the east of the building stood the library, generally occupied by interpreters attempting to unravel the visions of the Mystics.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tower of Prophecy was first mentioned on the [http://www.swtor.com Star Wars: The Old Republic] media website with the announcement of the planet Voss.<ref name="HoloVoss">{{Holonet|planets|voss|Voss}}</ref>
